entityDescription:
PortExpertise is a Belgian independent consultancy of maritime port professionals. Partners of PortExpertise are international experts and have at least 15 years of experience in among others strategy, financing and operations in maritime and port related sectors. They performed on research assignments and project management in more than 300 maritime ports and maritime terminal projects worldwide. The company has agents in Europe, Middle-East and Asia. PortExpertise is active in Worldbank and European Union projects, assisting international organizations, maritime authorities, port communities and the big five consultancy firms in port related projects.Further relevant references are PortExpertise’s representation of Belgium in the Expert Group on Maritime Simplification; Project manager for the Port Community Service Platform Project of 4 Flemish ports; Assistance to the Belgian SafeSeaNet national competent authority in major SafeSeaNet related matters; Projects are performed in EU’s top 10 of maritime Member States next to a long list of non-EU locations, which include among others: PortExpertise has an impressive proven track record on Port Community System and Maritime Single Windows on national, European and global level ever since 2006 with the PCSP (Port Community Service Platform) project, preparing the platform for the Flemish ports. Soon afterwards PortExpertise facilitated the European priority project (2012-EU-21019-S) AnNA (Advanced National Networks for Administrations 2013-2016) dealing with the adoption of the national Maritime Single Window and electronic data transmission for the fulfilment of reporting requirements for vessels entering and departing European ports in accordance with EC Directive 2010/65/EU. The next years similar projects enabled to expand this expertise on data exchange platforms related to Maritime/Port Environments and Inland Water Way transport, both for public and private entities/organizations. To name a few: Belgian Port Community System (PCS) a platform that offers services for 5 Belgian Maritime Ports;Pakistan Trade Facilitation (Project No. 1260332); DG Move Support action for contributing to the establishment of a European Maritime Single Window environment data set (Service contract MOVE/D1/SER/2018-377/SI2.789555); Revision of the Reporting Formalities Directive with the aim to establish European maritime single window environment (Contract MOVE/A3/119-2013); RIS Enabled European IWT Corridor Management (CoRISMA) 2012-EU-70004-S); MAiDEN, the Maritime Information Data Exchange Network Search & Rescue services, enhancing the interoperability between 5 coastal search and rescue partners (EASME/EMFF/2017/1.2.1.3); Maritime Single Window service delivery plan for Belgian authorities. Currently we are active in the Port of the Future project called DockstheFuture (No 770064) addressing (among others) the challenges related to simplification and digitalization of processes in maritime & port sector.
PortExpertise’s acted as Project manager of the Belgian Maritime Single Window (BMSW), related to Europe’s Reporting Formalities Directive. In this role PortExpertise developed a System Requirements Specification for the Belgian Maritime Single Window including i.e. the list of data elements, their technical definition and semantic meaning and further on analysed the national reporting requirements. They assisted DG MOVE into the first data harmonisation activities on the Maritime Single Window Data, by updating the country fiches, and developing a web based tool to facilitate harmonisation of this date from 23 Member States.

Hadean’s distributed compute platform offers a breakthrough in the power and scale of cloud-based IT infrastructure. Global organisations can now harness the full force of unlimited cross-cloud compute to solve their most complex problems, in real-time.

Hadean was founded to remove computational bottlenecks by enabling scaling without engineering and ops effort. Taking a first-principles approach to distributed computing, we developed our foundational technology - the Hadean platform - that provides the necessary and sufficient primitives and the strong execution guarantees to enable programmers to write networked, dynamically-scaling, distributed apps. It allows thin, robust programs to be built that scale from one core to thousands of cores reliably and predictably.
Hadean’s Aether Engine is a world-first distributed simulation engine built on top of the platform’s capability. Aether Engine allows programmers to write and deploy real-time simulations agnostic of the scale or distribution required at runtime.
We are tackling some of the hardest computational problems in society today, whilst continuing to explore alternative application areas in Research & Development. Hadean is based in London, UK, and is a currently a team of forty.

The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 410,000 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2018). The company generated sales of 78.5 billion euros in 2018. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. As a leading IoT company, Bosch offers innovative solutions for smart homes, smart cities, connected mobility, and connected manufacturing. It uses its expertise in sensor technology, software, and services, as well as its own IoT cloud, to offer its customers connected, crossdomain solutions from a single source. The Bosch Group’s strategic objective is to create solutions for a connected life. Bosch improves quality of life worldwide with innovative products and services that are “Invented for life” and spark enthusiasm.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 460 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. The basis for the company’s future growth is its innovative strength. At nearly 130 locations across the globe, Bosch employs some 68,700 associates in research and development.
The company was set up in Stuttgart in 1886 by Robert Bosch (1861–1942) as“Workshop for Precision Mechanics and Electrical Engineering”
The special ownership structure of Robert Bosch GmbH guarantees the entrepreneurial freedom of the Bosch Group, making it possible for the company to plan over the long term and to undertake significant upfront investments in the safeguarding of its future. Ninety-two percent of the share capital of Robert Bosch GmbH is held by Robert Bosch Stiftung GmbH, a charitable foundation. The majority of voting rights are held by Robert Bosch Industrietreuhand KG, an industrial trust. The entrepreneurial ownership functions are carried out by the trust. The remaining shares are held by the Bosch family and by Robert Bosch GmbH.

Morpheus Designs is a consulting firm specialising in the design and analysis of high performance thermal management and lightweight components using the design freedom offered by Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology. We believe that fundamental rethinking and redesign of products can result in better components in many applications.

Morpheus Designs offers a range of engineering solutions related thermal management and light-weighting using additive manufacturing. The main areas of consulting that Morpheus Designs will offer are:

1. Heat exchanger design and analysis:
- Concept generation: From a customer’s system requirements, Morpheus Designs can offer conceptual design, with detailed size and performance requirements, so the customer can assess if they can benefit for the AM solutions that can be provided. Advice about integration, cost, post-processing and other factors can be provided too.
- Thermal 1D analysis: Thanks to unique state-of-the-art analysis tools, Morpheus designs can validate their thermal design for a range of applications and conditions.
- FE analysis and lifing: To evaluate the structural performance and lifing of their customer’s products and designs, Morpheus Designs can provide Finite Element Analysis (FEA) services.
- CFD simulations and Validation: In order to validate their customer’s products and designs in terms of thermal and flow performance, we can provide CFD analysis services that can offer great insights into the performance of our clients design and help reduce. Both CFD and FEA can lower development costs by minimizing physical testing and help verify and validate the components.
- Thermal optimization: Morpheus Designs can combine their expertise in thermal analysis and optimisation to offer their customers with state-of-the-art optimization methodologies for thermal components.
2. Structural optimisation for lightweighting
- Topology optimisation: Topology optimisation is a method that calculated the minimum distribution of material based on the loads and constraints of a problem. Thanks to the experience within the team with such techniques for additive manufacturing components.
- Lightweight cellular structures: Morpheus Designs will develop tools for the generation of lightweight lattice structures that can be beneficial for a number of applications.
3. Design for AM process
- Design of AM components, applying process rules and limitations.
- Design of small-scale prototypes for experimental validation
- Build preparation solutions integrated within the same framework as the analysis and design tools. Including:
 - 3d printing files generation
 - Support structures automatic design, based on internal library
 - Scanning strategies for complex, very fine parts for heat exchangers and other complex parts such as lattice structures.

entityDescription: The National Institute for Infectious Diseases (INMI) "Lazzaro Spallanzani" is an historical public institution operating since 1936 in the field of infectious diseases. In 1996, it was officially appointed also as research institute for infectious diseases. In 2009, a transplant center was opened at INMI, for the first time in Italy inside an institute for infectious disease. INMI is the Italian centre of excellence for the care and basic, translational research in patients affected by infectious diseases. The mission of INMI is to provide high-quality clinical care for patients with infectious diseases with a special interest in HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, viral hepatitis, severe infections, emerging/re-emerging infections and infections in the immunocompromised host; to assist in the development of a global response in Italy and abroad to emerging/re-emerging diseases, including both highly contagious, naturally occurring and deliberately released, microorganisms; and to help integration among clinical, epidemiological and pre-clinical research with the aim of enhancing the diagnosis, care and prevention of infectious diseases. The Institute has epidemiologic, diagnostic, patient care and research facilities, all placed in a large campus, located in the central area of the city.INMI covers an area of more than 130,000 square meters with 15 buildings. The mission of the institute is; to provide state of the art clinical care for patients with infectious diseases with special interest in HIV, viral hepatitis, tuberculosis, emerging/re-emerging infections and infections in the immunocompromised and transplanted host; to assist in the development of a global response to emerging/re-emerging diseases, including both highly contagious naturally occurring and deliberately released microorganisms; to promote integration among clinical, epidemiological and pre-clinical research with the aim of enhancing the diagnosis, care and prevention of infectious diseases. INMI research agenda is focused on blood-borne pathogens, TB and emerging infectious diseases, HIV/AIDS and viral hepatitis for basic, pathogenetic, diagnostic, epidemiologic, care/treatment and prevention purposes. The available equipment allows to perform full range of genomic, transcriptomic and proteomic analysis, in addition to classical imaging, cultural and immunological studies. The availability of high containment laboratories allows to perform research activity on high threat pathogens.

Radiantis is a specialist manufacturer of both, advanced frequency conversion systems for laser tuning and instrumentation for optical diagnostics. The Company focuses on compact, fully-automated and reliable products including optical parametric oscillators (OPOs), harmonic generators for the scientific and OEM markets.
Radiantis´ technical capability regarding frequency conversion systems expands across the CW, pulsed and ultrafast time-scales, and its current product portfolio includes femtosecond and picosecond instruments with high conversion efficiencies at MHz repetition rates covering a broad spectral range from 200 to 4000 nm.

Radiantis was established in 2005 with the goal of enriching the photonics market with state-of-the-art, robust, easy-to-use frequency conversion systems and diagnostic instrumentation. Today, the Company strives at providing optimum products and service to its OEM customers of industrial diagnostic applications. Radiantis is also well integrated in the academic and research community and has a broad worldwide network of satisfied scientists utilising its advanced products across the US, Europe and Asia.
Devoted to achieving maximum customer satisfaction, the Company endows its team with top talents that constantly strive to develop the most innovative, cutting-edge and cost-effective solutions providing the best possible performance to meet the challenges faced by customers. To ensure on-time delivery of product quality and reliability, Radiantis designs and develops its state-of-the-art systems in brand new well-equipped premises, following the highest standards of manufacturing and quality control.

Starting with procedural questions, through methodical know-how in process design and product development, up to the complete product portfolio development and the implementation of complete systems, we offer besides our standard products tailor-made solutions.
